rendered: Cathode: the anode-free full cell uses pyrite, we employed pyrite (FeS2) for the cathode[1]. Because pyrite does not natively contain sodium, the cathode is presodiated before assembly: presodiated the pyrite cathode prior to cell assembly[2]. The cell is assembled from presodiated pyrite and carbon/Al current collectors, "corresponding to a discharged device state", so no sodium metal is present on assembly. Sodium metal forms only during the initial charge, when sodium ions are removed from pyrite and on the carbon/Al current collector to form sodium metal in situ[3]. Cathode capacity for the energy density: the energy density figure assumes a Na1.5FeS2 stoichiometry and a FeS2 capacity of 335 mAh/g[4] (mass basis: presodiated pyrite plus the carbon nucleation layer).
